howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: In three simple steps, create a dignified, lasting tribute space for the people who matter.
howItWorks.step1Body: Sign up for free and create a memorial page in just a few minutes — photo, dates, opening biography.
howItWorks.step2Body: Share the link with family and friends. Each one can publish testimonials, photos, and supportive messages.
howItWorks.step3Body: Memories add up, donations support the close ones, and the page stays online for as long as you want.

trust.title: A platform built for grief
trust.subtitle: Designed with respect — free and secure.
trust.freeBody: Creating and maintaining a memorial page is free and will stay free. No hidden fees.
trust.privacyBody: You control who can view and post. Public or private page — your choice.
trust.secureBody: Donations go through Stripe with bank-grade encryption.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Creating and maintaining a memorial page is entirely free. No intrusive ads, no hidden fees. Our model is supported by voluntary community donations.
faq.q2: How long does the page stay online?
faq.a2: The page stays accessible for as long as you want. You keep full control and can delete it at any time from your dashboard.
faq.q3: Who can post on the page?
faq.a3: You decide. The page can be public (anyone with the link can testify) or restricted (invitation only). You can also moderate testimonials before they go live if you wish.
faq.a4: Loved ones can receive donations via Stripe (credit card) directly to their bank account. No money passes through Testimona, and a fundraising goal can be set.

finalCta.title: Honor the memory of someone you love

about.title: About Testimona
about.lead: A platform dedicated to commemorating the departed — preserving memories and supporting families.
about.definitionBody: Testimona is a public social platform dedicated to the memory of the departed, where users can write testimonials, publish photos and videos, and make donations to the rightful heirs.
about.visionBody: Celebrate the lives of the departed by creating a space to share joyful memories that endure for relatives and future generations.
about.missionBody: Become the reference social platform for commemorating the lives of the departed, where loved ones publish testimonials and anecdotes that are shared, commented on, and preserved for future generations.
about.howStep1Body: Provide the person's name, add your memory, photos or videos.
about.howStep2Body: If no page exists yet, Testimona creates one automatically from the information you provided.
about.howStep3Body: Close relatives can expand the biography, moderate content, and organize a fundraiser.
